name: Elisa Barskaia
headline: Coach for Career and Personal Development
summary:
I am a multi-lingual European who has lived, studied and worked in four countries (Russia, Germany, UK, Italy) and enjoys intercultural environments. 

With a background in business, psychology and tech management and 18 years of professional experience in industry and higher education in various roles including strategy and career coaching, I find joy in a creative, interdisciplinary and open-minded approach to life. 

I am passionate about people and their potential. My mission is to empower and guide people on their individual career and personality development journey.

With a strong analytical side, hands on working experience at a DAX30 company and strategic mindset as well as an empathetic people centered approach I offer a structured yet highly individual coaching to my clients.

positions.title: Coach for personal and career development
positions.description:
3E Coaching
Enable. Empower. Evolve. 

The purpose of 3E Coaching is to provide input, guidance and support on your individual growth journey. 

I see myself as a guide on your journey and an enabler of personal and professional growth. I would like to see people thrive and reach their highest potential while keeping their work life balance and being their most authentic selves.

I do this in individual coaching sessions as well as in empowering group settings and workshops/retreats in collaboration with other coaches and facilitators for personal and professional growth.
